title: NCHART during Hurricane Florence recovery
description: Members of N.C. Helicopter and Aquatic Rescue Teams talk about their mission during Hurricane Florence recovery efforts.

transcript.text: I'm C.W.4 Jeremy Kegge. I'm the standardization instructor pilot, maintenance pilot, and NC Heart Pilot at the North Carolina National Guard.
As soon as the mission requests start coming in and the weather is flyable, we'll head out and evaluate whatever the rescue is,
and then hopefully conduct the rescues and get some people out of some less than desirable situation.
I'm Jamie Cook. I'm a fire captain with Rocky Mount Fire Department.
And for this, I'm a heart tech. Heart stands for Hilo Aquatic Rescue Technician.
Most of the time, you're that person's last chance, so it feels good to know that you're going out there making the difference
whether it is directing a boat team in or a ground crew in or whether you're affecting the rescue yourself.
